observations: Photos 0 and 1: one white games console held up by hand in a shop window, wrapped in clear plastic film.
Photos 0 and 1: the Xbox sphere logo is on the console; the top and one side carry the small perforated vent pattern of the Xbox One S body.
Photo 1: the front edge is seen at a steep angle; a disc slot cannot be confirmed or ruled out.
No controller, power cable, HDMI cable or box is shown.
Console is never shown switched on; no screen, serial label or rear ports are shown.
Shop posters and a dealer watermark are in both photos.

read_from: photo 0 Xbox logo on the console and One S vent pattern
photo 1 Xbox logo on the front corner and One S vent pattern

claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show the Xbox logo and the white perforated One S body.
The front face is not shown straight on in photo 1, so the missing disc slot cannot be confirmed; pricing it as All-Digital is already the lower case.
The slim One S body is visible in photos 0 and 1.

risks.risk: The console may not power on, may overheat or have a faulty HDMI port or storage.
risks.proof: A clip of the console switched on and connected to a screen, showing the home screen and the Settings, System, Storage page.

risks.risk: No controller, power cable or HDMI cable included.
risks.proof: One photo of everything that comes with the console laid out together.

risks.risk: Console could be banned from online play, locked to another account, or stolen.
risks.proof: A clip signing in and opening the online store, and a close-up of the serial label on the bottom of the console.
risks.if_unproven: as console with no online access, held for serial check before payment

risks.risk: It may be a disc edition, or the plastic wrap may hide a used or refurbished unit with marks.
risks.proof: A straight-on photo of the front face and a photo with the wrap removed.

proof_requests: Clip of the console powered on and connected to a screen showing the home screen and the storage page, with a handwritten code with today's date in shot.
Close-up of the serial and model label on the bottom of the console.
Photo of all accessories included: controller, power cable, HDMI cable.
Straight-on photo of the front face showing whether there is a disc slot.
Clip of the controller paired and working.
response.reason: The Xbox logo and One S body are visible in both photos, so it can be priced as an Xbox One S All-Digital Edition, the lower case of the One S line, console only and as not working until a powered-on clip is sent.
